what_this_is: Every authored row (62 literals, 62 paragraphs, 25 particle explanations, 8 rulings) read against its sentence in research/derived/pending/w32_layerb_derived.json (tokens, particle positions and function types, the translation) and speak_survival_cores.json (register, survival function). Checked: the paragraph names the real topic/subject, the predicate and the survival construction; the literal mirrors the Japanese order with each particle's role; each particle explanation names the function this occurrence has and quotes tokens present in the sentence (dictionary forms and contrasts excepted); each ruling fits the sense used in every token it reaches; pt-BR (no pt-PT), no em or en dash. Mechanical checks: full coverage of the derived residue (62/62/25/9 tokens), particle surface + function_type equal to the derived slot, ruling lemma + pos equal to every reached token.
identity: literals and paragraphs by key; particles by key#position; rulings by lemma|pos
verdict_semantics: ok true: merge the authored text as written. ok false: merge `corrected` instead; it carries only the fields that change (pt_literal, structure_explanation_pt, explanation_pt), every other authored field of the row stands. No row is rejected.

10647294.problem: 'Mais perto hospital' drops 一番: in pt it reads as the comparative ('closer'), the same scaffold 193308 uses for もっと安い. The superlative is the point of 一番近い.

corrected.pt_literal: O mais perto hospital (は, tópico) onde é (です) (か, pergunta)?

226989.problem: に is folded into the chunk (お + 先 + に) with no role; every other literal labels its particles, and this sentence's own particle row says に turns お先 into an adverb.

corrected.pt_literal: Antes (お + 先 + に, advérbio) descortesia faço (し + ます).

237476.problem: Ends on 'いますか pergunta se ela existe' with no step to what the sentence means (Você tem família?). The siblings 235430, 3549484 and 200568 all make the existe -> ter bridge; this one leaves 'does your family exist' as the reading.

corrected.structure_explanation_pt: ご家族 é 家族 com o ご de respeito, a família do outro, e vem como tópico com は. O verbo é いる, usado para a existência de seres vivos: いますか pergunta se ela existe, que é o jeito japonês de perguntar se a pessoa tem família.

gen-1c83f478ab11.problem: 'o pedido mais simples que existe' is an inflated absolute (translation_style §4); the sibling paragraph for 12890046 says the same thing plainly.

corrected.structure_explanation_pt: を marca 薬 como o objeto e ください pede que o outro o dê. É o molde substantivo + をください, o jeito mais simples de pedir uma coisa.

1271480.problem: 'pergunta o jeito de pensar do outro' reads in pt as asking about someone's mindset, not their opinion on the matter at hand; the paragraph also never names the predicate form (polite 思います + か).

corrected.structure_explanation_pt: どう ('como') vem direto antes de 思う, na forma polida 思いますか, e pede a opinião do outro. Em japonês se diz 'como você pensa', não 'o que você pensa'.

122101#2.note: function_pt names the general construction てもいい while the sentence has てもよろしい; accepted as the construction's name, the explanation quotes 入ってもよろしい.

172526#2.problem: 'é o objeto de 分かります' is false: 分かる takes no direct object (what is understood goes with が, 日本語が分かる). Calling the embedded question its object feeds the classic pt-BR slip *日本語を分かる. function_pt is fine and stays.

corrected.explanation_pt: か fecha a pergunta encaixada 今何時, 'que horas são agora', e transforma esse bloco no que se quer saber: é o conteúdo de 分かります, aquilo que a pessoa sabe ou não.

189309#3.note: function_pt override is not needed (the derived 'partícula de origem/ponto de partida' already fits a starting time), but the override is correct and matches bank usage ('ponto de partida no tempo'); left as is.
